title: Pan-Seared Irish Cabbage with Butter
description: A simple yet flavorful cabbage dish from Ireland, seared in a buttery skillet.
instructions: 1. Rinse the Irish cabbage and remove any damaged leaves.
2. Slice the cabbage into 1-inch thick wedges.
3. Heat the white butter in the skillet over medium heat.
4. Add the cabbage wedges to the skillet and sear for 5 minutes per side, or until tender and slightly browned.
5. Serve the pan-seared cabbage hot, garnished with additional white butter if desired.
